About Indu Coral

Indu Coral is a stilt + 5 floor residential development offering 2 and 3 BHK homes from 1,030 to 1,800 sq. ft. Designed to be 100% Vastu compliant, every home comes with dedicated EV charging, 24×7 CCTV coverage, and access to a full rooftop amenity deck.

  • TNRERA registered — TNRERA/29/BLG/0303/2025, dated 09.09.2025
  • EV charging point for every apartment, individually metered
  • Rooftop gazebo, yoga deck, and open party area
  • Gym, indoor games room, kids' play area, and senior citizens' sit-out
